title: transfer a user defined object to hitComponent
body:
**What project are you opening a pull request for?** - react-instantsearch **Summary** When using multi index is usual to want to pass informations of the index to the `hitComponent`. But there is no way to transfer props from a `Hits` component to a personal `hitComponent`. Only `hits` are passed. **Result** and then you can do stuff like ```js ... export class AlgoliaHit extends Component { constructor(props) { super(props) this.handleClick = this.handleClick.bind(this) } handleClick(e) { e.preventDefault() console.log('click from index: ', this.props.userObj.index); } render() { return (
) } } ```
